title: Colour seasons
description: The 12 colour seasons the Colour tab can suggest, with the palette shown for each. The person's chosen season is saved by id in settings.colourSeason.

name.description: Colour name shown under the swatch.

hex.description: Swatch colour as #rrggbb. Closet items are compared with it.

id.description: Stable id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Saved settings refer to it, so it is never renamed or reused once shipped.

name.description: Season name shown in the app.

family.description: The classic four-season group this season belongs to.

lead.description: The season's strongest characteristic, used to explain it.

traits.description: Where this season sits on the three axes the questionnaire and photo sampling score. The suggestion is the season nearest to the person's scores.

clarity.description: -1 soft and muted to 1 bright and clear.

summary.description: One or two sentences describing the season in plain words.

colours.description: The season's main palette, in display order.

neutrals.description: Base colours for basics, trousers, coats and shoes.

metals.description: Jewellery and hardware metals that suit the season.

avoid.description: Colours that tend to be hardest to wear for this season. Closet items nearest one of these are listed as outside the palette.

why.description: Why the colours to avoid don't suit, so people can judge colours not listed.
